tha-ap302:1.1: Anusaṃsāvaka.] Piṇḍāya caramānāhaṃ Vipassim addasaṃ jinaṃ / Uluṅkabhikkhaṃ pādāsiṃ dipadindassa tadino. // //
tha-ap302:2.1: Pasannacitto sumano abhivādes' ahaṃ tadā / anusaṃsāvayiṃ Buddham uttamatthassa pattiyā. // // Ito
tha-ap302:3.1: ekanavute kappe anusaṃsāvayim ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi anusaṃsāvanā phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap302:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Anusaṃsāvako thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap302:8.1: Citakaṃ Pārichatto ca Saddaṃ Gosīsasantharaṃ Padaṃ Padesaṃ Saraṇaṃ Ambo Saṃsāvako pi ca sattatālīsa gāthāyo gaṇitāyo vibhāvihi.
tha-ap302:10.1: Kaṇṇikāro Hatthidado Ālamban-Udakāsana Tuvaraṃ Thomano c' eva Ukkhepaṃ Sīsupadhānaṃ.
tha-ap302:11.1: Paṇṇado Citapūjī ca gāthā c' ev' esā *sabbaso* cattārīsa satānīha ekapaññāsam-eva ca.
tha-ap302:12.1: Pañcavīsasatā sabbā dvāsattari taduttariṃ tisatān apadānaṃ gaṇitā atthadassīhi.
